sequential_context: The completed native-tool paired experiment eliminated all zero-tool failures but improved Travel clean success only from 2/45 to 3/45, with candidate wins 3, losses 2, exact two-sided p=1.0, and only one task retained at least two of three seeds.
hypothesis: The original function-tags prompt preserves better task reasoning on some Travel tasks, but sampled generations often state an intent to call a tool without emitting the required tag. An output-format-only instruction may restore tool execution without the reasoning distribution shift caused by the native Llama tool template.

added_constraints: emit exactly one function tag and no surrounding prose when a tool is needed
use an empty object for no-argument functions
do not merely describe an intended tool call
wait for each tool result before the next call

fixed_clean_only_budget.baseline: base function_tags with identical task and seed pairs

claim_boundary: This is a sequential clean-only execution repair, not an attack or world-model result. It may be used to define a future victim protocol only if the paired gate is met; otherwise it remains counterevidence.
